articles.title: Adam Harasowski
sentences: During his studies, he undertook annual internships abroad, including in Sweden (1929), France (1930), and England (Balderton in 1927 and 1930; Basingstoke in 1928).
While in Balderton, he formed a friendship with Rita and Fred Wand, who later assisted him upon his arrival in England in late 1939.
From 1958 to 1980, he resided in Balderton, a district of Newark-on-Trent.
